name: @kickside/mcp-ui
title: KickSide MCP
description: MCP credentials manager web component for kickside/mcp, over the native MCP credential API.

wippy.description: Renders the MCP credentials manager (custom element kickside-mcp), mounted by the app shell for the /mcp nav item and available to any authenticated user. It lists the user's MCP credentials and mints new ones: a label, an optional TTL, public agent traits with per-trait context (the same capability editor agents use), and an optional whitelist of component subtrees picked from a tree browser (empty = everything the user can see). After minting it reveals the bearer token once, together with the server-provided public MCP endpoint URL and a ready-to-paste streamable-http client config snippet; existing credentials can be renamed or deleted. It takes no props and emits no custom-element events (both schemas are empty); all data flows through the @wippy-fe/proxy api client against /api/v1/mcp/* (traits from /api/v1/agents/traits), with 401s routed to the host auth handler.
